newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Investec unit starts Namibian operations.
newsitem.headline: Investec unit starts Namibian operations.

text.p: Investec Bank Ltd division Investec Asset Management on Friday announced it had started operations in Namibia.
The group said in a statement its Windhoek-based office would provide an asset management service to Investec's existing and potential client base in the southern African region.
"The focus of the operation will initially be institutional pension and provident fund management, as well as high net worth private client portfolio management," it said.
The group, which has assets under management exceeding 13-billion rand, said it was looking forward to greater regional economic integration and economic liberalisation.
"There is no better time for us to introduce our products and services to a market which is ready to broaden its horizon," it said.
The Investec group has an established international presence, with offices in the United Kingdom, Europe and the Far East while the asset management arm has established a strong retail base.
